description: This Java source file defines the LogWrapper class, which wraps Android's native Log utility to facilitate logging with a chainable structure. It offers methods for setting and retrieving the next LogNode in the chain and implements the println method to output logs and pass them down the chain.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class implementing LogNode that wraps Android's native logging utility, enabling chaining of log nodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, and optional Throwable, then passes the log to the next node.
